- The **digit 7 is excluded** (i.e., the password can only use digits from 0 to 6).

verified_state: The password consists of 4 decimal digits.
Decimal digits are the digits 0 through 9.
reflection.error_step: - The **digit 7 is excluded** (i.e., the password can only use digits from 0 to 6).
